Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q4 2019 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of META.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $5.33 per share.
Revenue guidance of $18.2 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q4 2019.
We generated $17.8 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
Thank you for the question. Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 605 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
Second question - Analyst:
How should we think about the cadence of revenue recognition in the second half?
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
